## What would you like added?

A clear description of the feature.

## Why it fits mini-gateway

How does it fit a stateless, minimal gateway (no database, no state, nothing saved)?

## Rough shape

Endpoint, config variable, or behaviour change you have in mind — if any.

## Notes

Large refactors need an issue discussion first. Do not paste API keys, tokens, or credentials in this issue.
